normalizationRecipe.fontSwap: Prototype is Heebo-native (--font-ui Heebo-first, --font-serif Noto Serif). This round serves the exact Google-static woff2 faces the contract-verification render loaded (css2 response localized, network blocked at capture); measured advance-identical in Chromium to the repo variable TTFs the .pen binds. UA-default control surfaces take var(--font-ui) with the metric-neutral line-height pins above.
normalizationRecipe.notes: v002 recipe CARRIED VERBATIM (design-rules §44: v002 judgment calls stand where the surface survived) and re-verified: every findReplace hit exactly once on the v003 standalone. v003 EXTENSIONS: (1) the v4.11 uplift re-pins the FULL variable vocabulary at the pane scopes — the override block re-declares the injected set at :root, `#appMain,.sp-md-backdrop`, `#cs-watchlist,#wlHeadSlot`, and `#appMain #cs-watchlist,#cs-watchlist .wl-modal-backdrop` (the v003 scope adds `.wl-modal-backdrop`), LAST in the document; injecting at :root alone leaves --axis/--grid/--tk-* shadowed by the pane block. (2) THE </body> TRAP: the inline SheetJS bundle carries a </body> inside a JS string — the injection anchors on the LAST </body> (lastIndexOf), never a first-match replace, which corrupts the bundle and silently drops the entire override block mid-script. (3) placeholder rule above. Squircle note carried: rounded shapes with radius >= 9 are authored as circular-arc PATH nodes (pen rectangle cornerRadius renders as a squircle) — do not simplify back to rectangles. Identity injections are recorded because the injection IS the reconciliation record. Dark :root/[data-theme] blocks left untouched — dark is uncontracted (design-rules rule 36); every bound token carries its dark value in the library/local definitions. NEW in v002: --ts-scrub injected at :root bound to the INK role (r87 scrubber token; the JS reads cvRoot(--ts-scrub)||--ink) — this REPLACES v001 DJ-002's error-role crosshair mapping per design-rules rule 37; --grid2/--det carried with the v001 --grid/--muted couplings. Squircle note for the re-export lab: rounded shapes with radius ≥ 9 are authored as circular-arc PATH nodes because pen's rectangle cornerRadius renders as a squircle (v001 probe finding, carried) — do not "simplify" them back to rectangles. AMENDMENT-2 ROUND (2026-09-04): this recipe was applied MECHANICALLY (script) to both the 222627a0… source and the 800fd465… standalone for the differential proof — every findReplace hit exactly once on both files; the only remaining delta between the two normalized documents was the D5 computeRows() patch.

normalizationRecipe.labSettings: Playwright Chromium 151.0.7922.34 headless, deviceScaleFactor 2, no font-rendering flags (probed: --disable-font-subpixel-positioning 3.64%, --font-render-hinting=none 3.53% on explainer-open — default rendering is the pen-closest lab); caret hidden, animations+transitions frozen via injected style (REQUIRED: the detail-modal dialog's open animation races the in-dialog chart's width measurement — unfrozen, the chart builds at the 500px fallback viewBox and renders stretched 265px tall vs the settled 510/260 the frames bank).
